name: B10-0090/2026 (ECR) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament says Nasry Asfura won Honduras's 2025 presidential election and should be recognised as the legitimate president-elect. It calls on the current government of Xiomara Castro to accept the official result from the National Electoral Council and allow a peaceful handover of power on 27 January 2026. It also condemns violence against opposition politicians, including an attack that seriously injured lawmaker Gladys Aurora López, and asks the European Union to help make the handover possible. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

- The Parliament recognises Asfura as president-elect and urges the current government to accept the result.
- It condemns violence against opposition members, including the attack on Gladys Aurora López.
- The EU is asked to help enable Asfura to take office on 27 January 2026.
